race:history:01.text: Quelle ville antique était le centre d'un empire dirigé par des empereurs comme Auguste ?

race:history:02.text: Quelle civilisation des Andes a construit le Machu Picchu ?

race:history:03.text: Quel peuple d'Amérique centrale a fondé Tenochtitlan ?

race:history:04.text: À quelle famille royale anglaise appartenaient Henri VIII et Élisabeth Ire ?

race:history:05.text: Quel nom donne-t-on aux marins scandinaves qui menaient des raids et faisaient du commerce à travers l'Europe ?

race:history:06.text: Quel dirigeant romain a franchi le Rubicon en 49 avant J.-C. ?

race:history:07.text: Quel leader de l'indépendance de l'Inde était connu pour sa résistance non violente ?

race:history:08.text: Quelle cité-État grecque était célèbre pour sa société de guerriers ?

race:history:09.text: Quelle civilisation antique a construit les pyramides de Gizeh ?

race:history:10.text: Quel est le premier mot du nom latin de la charte scellée par le roi Jean en 1215 ?

race:history:v2:11.text: Quel célèbre paquebot a coulé après avoir heurté un iceberg en 1912 ?

race:history:v2:12.text: Quelle ville allemande était divisée par un mur jusqu'en 1989 ?

race:history:v2:13.text: Quelle ville marchande italienne est célèbre pour ses canaux et ses gondoles ?

race:history:v2:14.text: Quel support d'écriture fabriqué à partir de roseaux les anciens Égyptiens utilisaient-ils ?

race:history:v2:15.text: Quelle ville a accueilli les premiers Jeux olympiques modernes en 1896 ?

race:history:01.backTranslation: Which ancient city was the centre of an empire ruled by emperors such as Augustus?

race:history:02.backTranslation: Which civilization of the Andes built Machu Picchu?

race:history:03.backTranslation: Which Central American people founded Tenochtitlan?

race:history:04.backTranslation: To which English royal family did Henry VIII and Elizabeth I belong?

race:history:05.backTranslation: What name is given to the Scandinavian seafarers who raided and traded across Europe?

race:history:06.backTranslation: Which Roman leader crossed the Rubicon in 49 BC?

race:history:07.backTranslation: Which leader of India's independence was known for his nonviolent resistance?

race:history:08.backTranslation: Which Greek city-state was famous for its society of warriors?

race:history:09.backTranslation: Which ancient civilization built the pyramids of Giza?

race:history:10.backTranslation: What is the first word of the Latin name of the charter sealed by King John in 1215?

race:history:v2:11.backTranslation: Which famous passenger liner sank after hitting an iceberg in 1912?

race:history:v2:12.backTranslation: Which German city was divided by a wall until 1989?

race:history:v2:13.backTranslation: Which Italian trading city is famous for its canals and gondolas?

race:history:v2:14.backTranslation: What writing medium made from reeds did the ancient Egyptians use?

race:history:v2:15.backTranslation: Which city hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896?
